summary: Hard cap on cumulative DRIVING time (excludes wait/service/setup).
constraints: Non-negative integer seconds; route driving time <= max_travel_time.
businessRules: An insertion raising driving time past the cap is rejected (task routed elsewhere/unassigned).

max_travel_time defines: Specify the total duration, in seconds, that the vehicle can be driven for. This is a constraint on the driving duration of the vehicle only and any wait, service or setup times spent towards the j…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.max_distance, vehicles.max_working_time, vehicles.time_window. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Values in seconds; must be non-negative. Zero means instantaneous.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Infeasible: nearest task's leg alone exceeds max_travel_time -> vehicle serves nothing.
Boundary: route driving time exactly max_travel_time accepted.
Interaction: Interaction: a 40-min wait for a late window pushes route end past the shift -> unassigned.
Interaction: Break duration: vehicle with max_working_time 480 and two 30-min breaks + 8h driving -> working time 480 (hits cap, no room for service).
Interaction: Layover: max_working_time 480, 120-min layover + 360-min driving -> working time exactly 480.
